body: The empty jar still holds a green film. A pencilled note tells the grounds crew to rinse the sprayed greens twice before they go to the kitchen, and counts the crates that came back with the film still on them.
title: The unfinished handoff

body:
The repair ticket orders the front doors welded shut at the checkpoint, but the locksmith billed for cutting off the back lock. A guard stood at the gap and turned away every family with a child.

The order had no name on it, only a stamp. I kept the scrap because the same stamp followed us from the previous stop. The first entry was crossed out; I have not tried to improve it.
title: One page put aside
